subject: SIG/CAIQ BCP evidence: RTO/RPO sampling window & live-witness coordination
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@treetopbank.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: SIG/CAIQ BCP evidence: proposed sampling window and live witness options

Hi Elena,

Thanks for sending over the SIG follow-up. Per your questionnaire item around BCP/DR evidence, we've sketched a short, audit-friendly plan to provide both the artifacts and a short live-witness session so your audit team can validate RTO/RPO claims. High level:

- Attachments: a snapshot of our recovery runbook excerpts, a small KV-cache telemetry sample from last warm-failover test, and the keystore rotation log.
- Desired live-witness windows: 2027-04-13 (10:00–11:00 ET) or 2027-04-14 (14:00–15:00 ET). We can support a remote screen-share and live Q&A.
- What we'll show during the witness: triggering the failover orchestration, RTO timeline slides, a replay of the telemetry showing KV warm-cache hit recovery, and the keystore rotation verification steps.
- Deliverables ahead of the call: PDF evidence packet + CSV telemetry extract and a link to a read-only S3 bundle.

Ben and Grace are cc'd — Ben will attach the artifacts and Grace will own the run-of-show during the witness. Can you confirm which window works for your team and whether you need a formal notarized attestation or just a recorded session?

Best,
Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales, Compliance & GTM
Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@treetopbank.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: security@treetopbank.com
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 08:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ BCP evidence: proposed sampling window and live witness options

Jonas, thanks — this looks helpful. A couple of clarifications from our side before we lock a time: 

1) For the KV-cache telemetry extract can you include both the warm-start timeline (timestamps for cache rehydration) and per-shard RPO deltas? We need to show end-to-end latency to our infra auditors.
2) We prefer the 2027-04-14 window 14:00–15:00 ET. Please include PST timestamps for your ops folks.
3) We will require a short signed attestation (one paragraph) that the artifacts reflect a production-like failover and were not run in an isolated dev env. Notarization is not required but the attestation should include an ops contact.

Also can you list what user accounts (roles) will be visible during the live session? Our security team will do a quick access review.

Elena

Elena Rossi
Senior Compliance Manager
Treetop Bank
elena.rossi@treetopbank.com | +1 212-555-0199
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@treetopbank.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ BCP evidence: proposed sampling window and live witness options

Elena — attaching the initial artifact set. See stubs below (full bundle uploaded to the shared link). Per your requests:

Attachments included (stubs):
- rwi_bcp_snapshot_20270406.pdf (runbook excerpts: failover steps, escalation contacts, RTO/RPO SLOs)
- kv-cache-sample-telemetry.csv (sample contains timestamps, shard_id, pre-failover_cache_hit_pct, post-failover_cache_hit_pct, rehydration_duration_ms)
- keystore-rotation-log-20270331.txt (rotation events, signer IDs, verification checksums)

Short answers inline: 
- We will include per-shard RPO deltas in the CSV. Column names: timestamp_utc, shard_id, rpo_ms_delta, kv_hit_pct_before, kv_hit_pct_after, rehydrate_ms.
- Live session roles: ops_user_1 (Read/Write deploy), ops_user_2 (Failover orchestrator), obs_viewer (read-only telemetry). We'll redact any personal usernames before the session — for the audit we'll provide role names + short role descriptions.
- Ops contact for attestation: Grace O'Connor (grace_oconnor@redwood.com).

Read-only bundle: https://redwood-share.example.com/s/treetop-bcp-evidence-202704 (expires 2027-05-07)

Let us know if you want us to produce an anonymized video capture ahead of time.

Cheers,
Ben

--
Ben Carter
Customer Security & Compliance Liaison
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@treetopbank.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 16:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ BCP evidence: final plan for 2027-04-14 live witness

Elena, thanks — confirmed for 2027-04-14 14:00–15:00 ET (11:00–12:00 PT). Final checklist for the live witness: 

- Pre-call deliverables (we'll share these by 2027-04-12 EOD): rwi_bcp_snapshot_20270406.pdf, kv-cache-sample-telemetry.csv, keystore-rotation-log-20270331.txt, and a one-paragraph attestation signed by Grace.
- On-call roles during session: ops_user_2 (will execute the failover), obs_viewer (will present telemetry), and Grace as the attestation signer and ops contact.
- Agenda (30–40 minutes): 1) 5-min intro + scope, 2) 15-min live failover demo (or replay if auditors prefer), 3) 10-min telemetry review (CSV walkthrough), 4) 5–10 min Q&A and attestation delivery.
- Recording policy: we will record only the telemetry panes and the orchestration logs; any PII / account-level identifiers will be redacted in the shared recording.

If that all looks good I will send calendar invite and the read-only link. Ben — please push the attestation PDF and the telemetry CSV to the share link by EOD Monday.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — looking forward to getting this closed for the SIG submission.

Best,
Jonas

--

Enterprise Sales, Compliance & GTM
Redwood Inference
